workload_requirements: p95 latency <250ms for agent-facing suggestion messages
peak bursts: up to 1500 tool-call requests/min during promos
idempotent tool-calls with client-supplied idempotency keys
guaranteed audit log retention 7 years (compliance ask)
structured JSON outputs for all tool-call payloads; schema validation required
model_preferences: low-latency quantized models for live assist (7B/13B int8 recommended)
fallback to smaller cheaper models for non-critical summarization
strict ability to pin model versions for auditability
routing_and_fallbacks: fallback region: eu-west-1 for data residency-required accounts
fallback model policy: degrade to 'summarization-only' variant when tool-calls are failing
policy: if Stripe API returns 429, queue and retry with exponential backoff; surface to agent after 3 failures
